title: The shared catch
purpose: Demonstrate the lesson through a collaborative visual solution and repair the practical mess.
visual_action: Yeti apologizes and asks what everyone sees. June marks the six bounce rhythms on her sketch. Tumble converts the stopped cart into a padded catcher. Mara and nearby vendors angle the connected awnings. Yeti listens, calls the count, and uses the lever at the precise moment. Its tag flips to ACTUAL GENTLE-GO as the cart rolls beneath the final converging bounces. The team catches all six and restores the stalls.
conflict: The last two berries will collide and escape unless Yeti trusts June's count instead of jumping early.
emotional_shift: Embarrassment becomes focused trust, then shared delight.
props_out: all six escaped berries returned to secured basket
lever tag flipped to ACTUAL GENTLE-GO
continuity_in: Berry positions match SC-004 continuity out.
Tumble begins safely freed from the banner with his official creator-approved design unchanged.
All characters remain barefoot or on uncovered natural paws; lower-body action never introduces footwear.
continuity_out: Basket now has a double knot tied by Juniper and sits at Mara’s stall.
All characters return to their established pre-chase appearance; no clothing, accessory, color, marking, or anatomy changes.
Yeti carries the empty auxiliary catching basket.
Market is ready to open with no damage.
transition_out: The community bell rings as the final restored slate sign flips from CLOSED to OPEN.
